_help: Cross-platform as-is: mutool (MuPDF's CLI, part of the mupdf-tools package on Linux, the mupdf cask/formula on macOS, scoop's mupdf on Windows) has the same CLI everywhere. "discrete" paging: probeCmd runs "mutool info" and probePattern pulls the real page count for this specific file out of its "Pages: N" line, since a PDF's page count varies per file instead of being a fixed setting. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: mutool draw -o <exact-path> file.pdf <page> renders straight to the given filename with no page-number suffix, matching %OUTPUT%'s contract; poppler's pdftoppm always appends its own suffix to the output prefix instead, which doesn't fit without extra handling — hence mutool here despite pdftoppm/pdfinfo also being common.
